items.headline: Cloud Infrastructure Firm CloudFerro Is Said to Weigh Warsaw IPO
items.excerpt: Polish cloud infrastructure provider CloudFerro SA is considering an initial public offering in Warsaw as soon as next year, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: Anthropic Falls After Blockbuster Debut as Tech Sells Off
items.excerpt: Anthropic shares erased much of their first-day surge as the record-breaking listing faces its first test from public investors. Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary discusses what's ahead for the company with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.excerpt: Anthropic shares are retreating after their blockbuster debut, but T. Rowe Price’s Emma Norchet says the volatility doesn’t change the firm’s long-term outlook. items.headline: Big Take: Can Anthropic Weather a Shifting AI Landscape?
items.excerpt: Volatility surged a day after the market debut of Anthropic. Worries over AI, geopolitics and rates are all weighing on investors’ appetite for risk. Ed Ludlow and Bailey Lipschultz join Sarah Holder on the Big Take podcast to explain. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Nvidia Employees Complained About Huang’s Behavior Years Ago
items.excerpt: About two decades ago, two Nvidia Corp. employees complained about how then-Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang treated his staff, including allegations that he threatened them and made sexually explicit remarks, according to allegations contained in a California lawsuit filed in 2007.

items.headline: Anthropic Founder to Donate to Trump Accounts Following IPO, Bessent Says
items.excerpt: Tom Brown, a co-founder and chief compute officer of Anthropic PBC, plans to announce a donation to Trump accounts, according to a person briefed on the matter.

items.headline: Microsoft to Pay Top Cloud Workers More, Crack Down on Others
items.excerpt: Microsoft Corp. is making pay more performance-based in its crucial cloud division, the latest tech industry attempt to push employees to work even harder.

items.headline: Trump Vows to Tax US Companies Building Data Centers Abroad
items.excerpt: President Donald Trump said Friday that he wants to tax companies that build data centers outside the United States. Trump spoke during a press conference at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Musk Ally Akis Joins Board of DOGE Alumni Firm After New Round
items.excerpt: Elon Musk ally Baris Akis is joining the board of Special, a company led by two former staffers from the Department of Government Efficiency, Musk’s controversial government cost-cutting project.

items.headline: YouTube Finalizing Multibillion-Dollar Schools Settlement Over Addiction Claims
items.excerpt: Google’s YouTube is finalizing a multibillion-dollar settlement payout to school districts across the US that have accused the company of designing an addictive video platform that has damaged the mental health of students, people familiar with the matter said.

items.excerpt: Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed the latest from Apple with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney. items.headline: S&P 500 Heads for Correction as AI Enthusiasm Keeps Unwinding
items.excerpt: A slide in the S&P 500 Index on Friday pushed it into a correction territory after a string of disappointing Big Tech earnings and scandal at Nvidia Corp. eroded confidence in the artificial intelligence trade.

items.headline: Europe Retail Traders Bid Seven Times Anthropic’s IPO Allocation
items.excerpt: Retail investors in continental Europe submitted orders for about seven times more stock than they were ultimately allocated in Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, who asked not to be identified as the information is confidential.

items.headline: KKR in Talks to Buy EdgeCore at Valuation of at Least $8 Billion
items.excerpt: KKR & Co.’s Helix Digital Infrastructure, the company it launched this year to invest in data centers and other AI-related businesses, is in negotiations to buy a majority stake in EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: Emerging Market Stocks on Cusp of Bear Market as AI Rout Expands
items.excerpt: Emerging-market stocks extended their declines for a seventh day on Friday, with MSCI’s equity index on the cusp of a bear market amid a continued selloff in global tech shares.
